statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains low while fresh granular overnight NQ path evidence is limited and the next concentrated conditional risk window is the September 23 U.S. open and Flash PMI.
headline: Low Tail overnight; September 23 cash open and Flash PMI remain the main conditional risk window
body: Fresh granular NQ price-path evidence for the reopened overnight session is not sufficiently verified. The prior U.S. session showed a material retracement from record-area highs rather than persistent extreme holding. VIX closed low, and geopolitical/rates uncertainty keeps Stress elevated.

lookbackSummary: Tail was mostly low during the prior 24 clock hours. WATCH appeared at 04:00, 15:00 and 16:00 UTC, while 14:00 UTC briefly reached 27% elevated; Stress remained predominantly extreme.
outlookSummary: Overnight Tail stays low unless NQ develops persistent extreme holding or repeated failed retracements. The main conditional danger window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the U.S. cash open, 13:45 Flash PMI and early post-release price discovery.
